subject: Following up: pricing estimate and a quick 15-minute walkthrough?
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy@asterhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Estimate attached: Redwood Inference dedicated capacity (Aster Health)

Hi Amy —

Great speaking with you earlier. Quick recap from today's discovery and next steps attached:

- Goal: reduce inference costs for patient-facing summarization while keeping latency under 120ms median.
- Current constraints: PCI-adjacent PHI concerns, need VPC or private deployment options.
- What we proposed: Dedicated pool + KV caching + prefix caching to meet latency SLOs.

Attached is the estimate we discussed (Aster_Estimate_Redwood_v2.pdf). Highlights:
- 12-month committed capacity (mix of p3x + g5) with burst credits
- Estimated token cost savings vs. cloud-managed endpoints
- Optional private deployment add-on for audit logs/KMS integration

Would you mind confirming receipt? If helpful I can walk through the pricing in 15 minutes — proposed slots: Tue 3/16 10:00-10:15 PT, Wed 3/17 11:00-11:15 PT, or Thu 3/18 14:00-14:15 PT. You can also pick a time here: https://cal.com/kimberly/15

Attachments: [Attachment: Aster_Estimate_Redwood_v2.pdf (PDF, 124 KB)]

Thanks — looking forward to hearing where this lands on your priority list.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
